title: Before Your First Party Barge Cruise
why: Warm planners booking a first cruise: answer the 3 questions that cause day-of problems (cooler, arrival, weather).
hook_options: Three things to know before you board
Planning the cruise? Read this first.
The 60-second briefing for your first Clear Lake cruise
caption:
Planning your group's first Clear Lake cruise? Three things: no glass in the cooler (cans and plastic only), show up early because public cruises can't wait, and rain is fine because the boat has a roof. Save this for whoever's planning. 🧊⏰🌧️

slides.headline: First party barge cruise? Three things to know.
slides.body: Cooler rules, arrival time, and what happens if it rains. Save this for whoever's planning.

slides.headline: Anything you like. Just no glass.
slides.body: BYOB and bring your own food. Cans and plastic only. Cupcakes are fine. Skip the cake and rice, too messy.

slides.headline: Early. Public cruises can't wait.
slides.body: Ubers cancel and traffic can be bad. Directions come with your booking, and every guest signs the waiver link before boarding.

slides.headline: What if the forecast looks bad?
Rain is fine. Lightning isn't.
slides.body: The boat has a roof. We check the weather by 7am. If we cancel, you get a full refund or a free reschedule.

slides.headline: Ages 8 and up. No dress code.
slides.body: Life jackets and a bathroom on board. A professional captain drives. You handle the playlist.

slides.headline: No glass. Show up early. Rain is fine.
slides.body: That's the whole briefing. The rest is your group, your music, and Clear Lake.

slides.headline: Ready for your first one?
slides.body: Public cruises or the whole boat for up to 26 guests. Book at houstonpedalbarge.com.
